execution.mechanism: klt sim --backend batch (2am EDA batch fleet, Spot)
execution.timing_note: elapsed_s per corner is the remote engine wall clock reported by klt (runtime_s). job_elapsed_s is the fleet harness's own job time. queue_provision_and_transfer_s = submit-to-collect wall minus job_elapsed_s (S3 upload, Spot acquisition/boot, polling granularity, download).

experiment.claim: README.md 'Target specification' (DR-005, amended by DR-006) row 'PSRR' (> 60 dB DC-1 kHz target; > 30 dB @ 1 MHz stretch, out of scope for wave 1 per DR-001), for the 3.3 V primary flavor, measured at SCHEMATIC level on design/bandgap_core.sch WITH design/startup_injector.sch attached to the same GDRV/VREF/VDD/VSS nets -- i.e. the circuit the composed layout has actually contained since issue #285, with no extraction step in the loop. Everything except the attached injector is identical to sim/psrr-dc/ (row 4a): same open-circuit VREF readout, same 1 V AC magnitude on the supply so v(vref) is the supply-to-reference transfer function and PSRR = -db(v(vref)), same 45-corner PVT matrix, same measurements, same DR-006 60 dB DC-1 kHz band-min floor. This bench exists to settle issue #300: it discriminates between the two competing explanations for row 4b's post-layout FAIL 25/45 (design property of the injector's MPC1/MPC2 reference stack vs. a klt extract --parasitics artifact, klayout-tools#2359). It is a diagnostic companion to row 4a, not a replacement for it -- row 4a remains the bare-core schematic PSRR claim, and the difference between the two rows IS the injector's cost with extraction held out.
experiment.title: Power-supply rejection ratio, DC-1 kHz band + 1 MHz spot, untrimmed core WITH the startup injector attached (schematic level)

spread_checks.note: DC rejection must move by at least 0.5 dB across the 45-point matrix. A dead-flat result would mean the corner/temperature/supply knobs are not reaching the simulator.
